The 'Body' and 'Coat' checkpoints were marked present, which aligns with the visual evidence of a large, corded white dog. The 'Tail' checkpoint was correctly marked untestable as it is obscured. The Router was not too lenient; in fact, marking the body silhouette as 'present' despite hidden musculature is a reasonable inference for this specific breed where the coat defines the shape.

I agree with the paw assessment; the cords merge into the grass without clear grounding or compression shadows, a common AI artifact for this subject. The background anomaly is also valid—the objects on the fence lack coherent geometry. The Perceptual Quality Auditor noted 'noise' (severity 0.4), which is minor compared to the structural issues. The Topology Auditor's high mask confidence (0.99) confirms the dog is a single entity, but does not refute the grounding issue at the feet. The severity of the paw artifact is significant enough to lower the artifact score below the 'high quality' reference.

The score is slightly reduced from perfect because the hidden features prevent 100% verification, but the visible evidence is overwhelming.
